notes.title: Robotpumpkin Games' Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey is Now Available
notes.content:
[i][b]Evade Suspicion and Pass for a Totally-Normal-Human-Person in this new Sci-fi Comedy Text Adventure from RobotPumpkin Games[/b][/i]

[u]The wait is over and Earthly exploration awaits![/u]
Together with developer [i][b]Robot Pumpkin Games[/b][/i] we are happy to announce today the Windows PC, iOS, and Android launch of Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey, a comedic sci-fi text adventure. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/d10a3e33ce9bedd265194bf96acd58d31bac4ce0.gif[/img][/url]

Get [b]Plan B From Outer Space[/b] with an out-of-this-world launch discount of 20% off!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/

[b][i]ACK AC...no...Klaatu barada nik...damn it...[/i]Pack mas![/b]

[h3]Watch the Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey launch trailer now: [/h3]
 [previewyoutube=2N-mzA-GJPo;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey: [/h3]
[b]Plan B From Outer Space[/b] leverages choose-your-own-adventure-style gameplay to hilariously tell the daunting tale of a castaway alien who’s taken an unforeseen “vacation” in the Germanic South. Stranded on this bizarre beer-soaked and pretzel-salt encrusted world, a now earthbound E.T. must keep their wits about them to avoid detection. 
[b]With over 19 unique endings[/b], each decision made will affect the way the story unfolds. 
Get immersed in the beautiful hand-drawn scenery, colorful culture, and traditional cuisine...or else rouse the locals’ suspicions. 

Subvert the “Alien Invader” trope by taking on the persona of one. 
The mission? 
Once the crash and culture shock wear off, explore the cozy Bavarian town of Unter-Hinterobersdorf, located in the beautiful scenic Germanic countryside, and stay under the citizens’ radar while fixing your radar (and the rest of the ship while you’re at it). 
Design a cute and cuddly or funky fresh Martian visitor and utilize the Aliens’ shapeshifting abilities for some bonafide “Barbvarian” blending-in. 
With engaging minigames that progress the narrative, a charming story, and gorgeous illustrations, P[b]lan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey[/b] is sure to be an unforgettable, out-of-this-world adventure.

[h3]Features of Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey: [/h3]
[list][*] [u][b]“Basic” Bavarians Meet “Extra” Terrestrials:[/b][/u] Design your very own cute, cuddly, and conniving space creature with unique features and a touching backstory.
[*] [u][b]Make the Right (or Funniest) Decision:[/b][/u] With 19 possible endings, every choice matters, which means plenty of trial and error with comedic results.
[*] [u][b]Big Brain Blobs:[/b][/u] Use those alien wits to solve fun, challenging mini-games and discover handy (or tentacle-y) items to help you escape the savage backwater of Southern Germany.
[*] [u][b]Handmade German Craftsmanship:[/b][/u] Dozens of beautifully illustrated backgrounds and animated characters breathe life and personality into this sci-fi comedy experience.[/list]

[h3]Save The World![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41040560/df408c02a45712c0ef176639dcb3c444d38174de.png[/img][/url]
Keeping with Assemble Entertainment’s usual theme, [b]Plan B From Outer Space[/b] is also available in a special [b]"Save The World"[/b] edition. 
This edition supports [i][b]‘BUND Naturschutz’[/b][/i] the largest environmental protection association of Bavaria and includes the game’s official soundtrack.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1683620/Plan_B_from_Outer_Space_A_Bavarian_Odyssey/


[h2]Developed by [i][b]RobotPumpkin Games[/b][/i] and published by [i][b]Assemble Entertainment[/b][/i], [b]Plan B from Outer Space: A Bavarian Odyssey[/b] is available now on Steam![/h2]

notes.title: The Innsmouth Case is Out Now on Xbox One and PlayStation 4 Consoles!
notes.content:
Crack the Case and Save the Girl...

Following the successful launches on PC and Nintendo Switch, together with developer [i][b]Robot Pumpkin Games[/b][/i], we are thrilled to announce that [b]The Innsmouth Case[/b] is out today for
Xbox One and PlayStation 4 consoles. 
This scary-comedy-text-adventure game set in the mysterious and foreboding Lovecraft universe is available from your respective Microsoft Store and the PlayStation Store.

[h3]Watch the release trailer for The Innsmouth Case on YouTube:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=ivpQ2HE7knc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]About The Innsmouth Case[/h3]
[b]The Innsmouth Case[/b] takes players on a truly harrowing, humorous, and fantastical
journey where nothing is what it seems. It’s a game of cat-and-mouse with sinister forces in the tenebrous town of Innsmouth, a place packed to the gills with nameless horrors, and it’s your job to stay alert, stay safe, and solve the case of the missing girl. 
To solve the enigmatic disappearance of little Tabitha Marsh, the most clever detective is not only wanted but desperately needed. 
Unfortunately, that particular detective is busy, so the case goes to you! Pack your belongings and prepare to head to the remote fishing village of Innsmouth, as The Innsmouth Case awaits!

[b]Crack the Case and Save the Girl... It’s the Only Way to Survive Innsmouth![/b]

[h3]Features of The Innsmouth Case[/h3]
[list][*] Become one with the Lovecraftian world around you, as each and every decision you make has a permanent effect on the ongoing story.
[*] The “interactive book” styled gameplay captivates with its perfect blend of offbeat humor and classic horror.
[*] Your fate is entirely in your hands; a total of 27 possible endings are to be discovered. Are you saving the day - or are your days in Innsmouth, and the world, numbered?
[*] Explore 21st century Innsmouth, talk to more than 20 animated characters and solve the mystery of the disappearance of Tabitha Marsh.[/list]

[b]The Innsmouth Case is available now on Xbox One and PlayStation 4 and is also available on Nintendo Switch, Windows-PC and MacOS (here on Steam, link below), iOS and Android mobile devices.[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231950/The_Innsmouth_Case/

notes.title: The Innsmouth Case - Small Update adds setting to toggle candle flickering
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Innsmouthonians![/h3]
As we reading your feedback carefully, we recently made aware of that the general flickering of candles in the game, can have an impact on the overall gameplay-experience.
Therefore, with today's small update, we added a a setting to the main menu ingame, enabling players to toggle the flickering of candles on, or off.

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list][*][b]Checkbox to enable/disable candle flickering has been added to the main menu settings[/b][/list]

[b]Thank you for your ongoing support, passion and dedication for our game!
Please keep it up! [/b]

notes.title: Holiday Chills for Lovecraft Fans - The Innsmouth Case Now Available for Switch!
notes.content:
Together with developer Robot Pumpkin Games, we have today released 'The Innsmouth Case', a scary-comedy-text-adventure game set in the mysterious and foreboding Lovecraft universe, on Nintendo Switch! 

[h3]As a special holiday bonus, you can secure your copy with a limited time 35% launch discount via the Nintendo eShop![/h3]
https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/The-Innsmouth-Case-1886844.html

[b]The Innsmouth Case is also available for Steam, iOS and Android.[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231950/The_Innsmouth_Case/

[h3]Watch the Nintendo Switch Release Trailer on YouTube:[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVZvwtu1OmU&feature=youtu.be


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36705894/8a6115ff57adc3709db3cd379400c825a474970f.png[/img]
[h3]About The Innsmouth Case:[/h3]
A desperate mother, a missing girl and a mystical place - a case could hardly be more challenging. To solve the enigmatic disappearance of little Tabitha Marsh, however, the toughest and cleverest detective of all is wanted... but he does not have the time - and so the job goes to you. This mysterious assignment takes you to the remote fishing village of Innsmouth, where nothing is what it seems…

Save the girl, solve the case, survive Innsmouth!

The Innsmouth Case is a detective adventure in the style of an interactive book inspired by the fantastical works of horror legend H.P. Lovecraft. The unique mixture of horror and humor makes The Innsmouth Case the first scary-comedy-text-adventure of its kind. A game in which every decision counts, and there is far more than one way to successfully solve the case ... or fail miserably!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36705894/7ab4f40bfa27e6c8a400c9649bb068fe117a4d5d.png[/img]
[list][*] Become part of a stirring story in the Lovecraft universe, where every decision you make has a lasting effect on the story.
[*] This interactive book will captivate you with its perfect blend of offbeat humor and classic horror.
[*] What fate awaits you in Innsmouth is entirely in your hands; a total of 27 possible endings want to be discovered. Are you saving the day - or are your days numbered
[*] Explore 21st century Innsmouth, talk to over 30 animated characters and solve the mystery of the disappearance of little Tabitha Marsh.[/list]

notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks to your feedback we have put in some new additions to the game and of course made some further improvements to the game!

[h1]Additions/Improvements[/h1]
[list][*] We have added a short explanation of the saving mechanics to chapter 1.

[*] The "Cthulhu fthagn" achievement is now correctly connected to the story endings instead of the achievements.

notes.title: The Innsmouth Case is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36705894/8144ef027e54f9f94ceecd10c8ee438e5d420dbc.jpg[/img]

[i][h2]- "You've got a good feeling about this. The secret is to make a good impression, so as not to scare away and potential opportunities."[/h2][/i]

Like our protagonist in "The Innsmouth Case", we have a good feeling and are happy about the release of our text adventure game, inspired by the fantastic works of horror legend H.P. Lovecraft - the unique mixture of horror and humor makes "The Innsmouth Case" the first scary comedy text adventure of its kind.

Immerse yourself in the spooky yet strangely familiar world of Innsmouth and try to live up to your calling as a private detective. Crazy characters and gripping dialogues let a few hours pass quickly as if you were searching for the answer yourself.

We would be very happy to hear about your experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36705894/b30d9830e0f55008c0985c5f4d8b9ae7baa5dad0.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231950/The_Innsmouth_Case/

[h2]We will be streaming some chapters of The Innsmouth Case today [b]4PM CEST[/b] on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/assembleentertainment]Twitch channel[/url]. Join in and have a first look into the game! [/h2]

[b]We wish everyone a lot of fun![/b]
[i]- Your team from RobotPumpkin Games & Assemble Entertainment -[/i]

notes.title: Come to Innsmouth and talk with the Devs
notes.content:
Come and visit Innsmouth – before [b]The Innsmouth Case[/b] will be released on June 23rd – the picturesque coastal village of Innsmouth will open its gates for everyone! The official demo will be available throughout the Steam Game Festival. You can download the demo from the game's Steam Store Page right here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1231950/The_Innsmouth_Case/][b]The Innsmouth Case[/b][/url]


You'll also have the chance to drill the developers with your questions during an AMA on June 22, 9am PDT/6pm CET.

Join our official [url=https://discord.gg/assemble-entertainment][b]Assemble Entertainment Discord Server[/b][/url] and have a nice chat with the developers of [b]The Innsmouth Case[/b].

And don't forget: the rumors about all the disappeared tourists are fake news – there's nothing to be afraid of!

See you soon!
